condition_c_loader.note: C and D consume the same structure record; D would need an episode run to exercise the readout path, which this task does not perform. The graph file is opened through load_structure and is never modified.

compliance.note: Every BANC-scale randomisation in this set started below the REV4 §9.3 4.00 GB free-memory gate and therefore is a recorded deviation from the protocol's operational constraint, not a compliant run. The documented 0.75 GB construction preflight passed for every seed and no build exhausted memory (peak RSS about 527 MB, lowest observed free memory 1.63 GB), so the safety rationale held in practice; the rule itself was not met and is not reported as met.

regeneration_provenance.note: A carried-forward result was computed by an earlier run of this command against the same certificate; it is reused only when the graph and certificate SHA-256 still match.
